name: exploratory
description: Work with Exploratory Desktop, search and read published content (notes, dashboards, charts, analytics and data), and query data on the server.

ai_summary.title: AI Summary output
ai_summary.description: Whether to create and save an AI Summary for charts and analytics you create

save_comments.title: Save comments
save_comments.description: Whether to save an explanatory comment on charts you create

review_hook.title: Review hook
review_hook.description: false: never review. true: ask the agent to review its work. The review runs before the first chart or analytics create, after wrangling, after a note is created, and after chart and analytics create or edit calls (once per chart or analytics, up to 8 charts and analytics together per session).

plan_gate.title: Plan gate
plan_gate.description: true: after an R report (HTML) is saved, refuse create calls until the agent saves a plan file (<title>_Exploratory作成計画.md). Also refuse custom R steps (exp_custom) that start in the wrong form. The custom R check refuses once an expression that a product command can do. false: do nothing.
